backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/integrations/webhook.rs:1066 — public POST /integrations/webhooks/portal/{connection_id} (mounted at webhook.rs:98, handed to external portals as the callback URL at install.rs:1673) reads the X-Webhook-Signature header, logs 'Webhook signature present', and returns 200 without ever verifying an HMAC; its OpenAPI doc advertises '401 Invalid signature' (webhook.rs:1041) that the handler never emits.

Currently inert (parsed payload is discarded), but a latent trust hole the moment any side effect is wired into this handler — unlike sibling Airbnb/Stripe/portal receivers which HMAC-verify before acting.
